headroom.applies_to: all non-protected elements; the protected payoff clip is never trimmed
headroom.policy: one trim shared by every candidate, solved from the hottest
headroom.why: Summing four elements at the arc's setup levels drove the authored body past full scale. The resulting hard clipping differed per candidate (1,980 / 2,239 / 2,488 flat-topped samples) and the setup differed too (178 / 87 / 218), so the frontier would have varied in distortion as well as in timing law and could not have isolated the mechanism it exists to test. A per-candidate trim would have swapped that confound for a level confound, so the trim is shared.

intent.control_or_baseline: the retained gold-v7 arc (38.15 s) and its protected gold-v6 payoff
intent.musical_gap: A1-07 has never produced an owner-reviewable performance long enough to show whether the groove survives setup, development and payoff. Every prior candidate is an 18.95 s core or a 38.15 s arc.
intent.owner_audition_effect: the owner hears a full-form 45-120 s performance and can judge whether the pocket holds across a real form, not a fragment
intent.rejected_ancestry: reference_zero_v5 is explicitly NOT a target output; the CORE ledger closed the existing automatic recipes. Its value here is timing and stage semantics only.

known_inherited_defects.affects: nothing in this descent's rendered candidates
known_inherited_defects.defect: the gold-v7 arc file itself hard-clips: 382 flat-topped samples across 58 runs, all inside its build section
known_inherited_defects.disclosure: state in the cut notes that the reference, not the options, carries the ancestor's clipping, so the owner does not read it as an option defect
known_inherited_defects.how: the shared headroom trim keeps the summed mix at -1.0 dBFS, so no full-form candidate carries a flat-topped sample; the INCUMBENT reference cut still carries the ancestor's own clipping because it IS the ancestor

machine_gate.band_tempo_bounds_rationale: The retired phrase_local map reached atempo 0.334 and a raw ratio of 10.51. Uncapped scaling is the mechanical source of the owner's 'instrumental dragged down to the vocal' verdict. Every band slot in this descent stays inside the same duration-preservation cap the terminal calls already used.
machine_gate.hard_clipping_is_a_frontier_validity_gat: Flat-topped samples are irreversible and they differed per candidate, so they would have confounded the timing-law comparison. This is not a mastering preference; an unequal defect invalidates the frontier.
machine_gate.why_raw_peak_is_not_gated: The retained gold-v7 arc already true-peaks at +0.2 dBFS, so every descendant that keeps the arc verbatim inherits it. Gating the raw render would either fail the whole frontier for an ancestor's defect or invite quietly rescaling the protected material. The raw peak is therefore recorded as evidence, the ceiling is enforced on the level-matched owner cut, and the inherited clipping is disclosed in the cut notes.

band_gain_arc.doctrine: the retained v7 quiet-to-crescendo shape, extended to full level in the body

band_grid.progressive_entry: Band tracks legitimately occupy DIFFERENT subsets of the shared slot grid: harmonic material enters first, then bass, then drums. A timing law maps the GRID; each track follows its own slots. This is why gold-v9 derive_slots, which demands identical slot sets across donor tracks, cannot be reused unchanged.
band_grid.why_lead_in: the arc already hands into its payoff on a vocal-only bar; the body repeats that gesture so the payoff entry reads as intentional

phrase_map.doctrine: Explicit and inspectable. Every phrase declares its own source window, destination anchor, timing law, reset behaviour, gain and transition treatment. No global opaque warp is permitted anywhere in this descent.

vocal_phrases.transition_treatment: hard start; the vocal is the clock the band enters against

vocal_phrases.measured_from: activity-segment census of the CORE four_seasons vocals stem
vocal_phrases.transition_treatment: contiguous source span, so the internal breath at 41.645-42.005 s is preserved exactly rather than spliced out

review_label_policy.reason: A tracked candidate-to-letter table is not a blind: anyone holding the repository could decode the verdict. Labels are permuted per pack under a nonce that lives only in the private review authority.

review_normalization.applies_to: owner review cuts only; never to the evidence renders or the protected payoff

dimensions: desire to hear the next phrase
review_policy.why_single_variable: the newly authored body is held byte-invariant across A, B and C so the frontier tests exactly one mechanism. A frontier that varied both the body and the timing law would be non-discriminating by construction.

source_identities.disambiguation: maneskin_drums here is the FULL CORE stem ec5a6646..., NOT the 45-75 s window object 3efb8521... used by the retired 20 s timing-pass lineage.

terminal_logic.next_after_review: promote a winner as the first owner frontier and rerun the production preflight, or on reject_all close the timing and arrangement family and change organs rather than generating another nearby timing specimen

timing_laws.frontier_role: best stable timing law under the retained positive arc
timing_laws.label: single-speed
timing_laws.mechanism: one constant tempo scale across the entire donor-band grid, chosen to preserve the grid's conducted span; slots reflow continuously from the first cue
timing_laws.why: the best stable timing law carried forward from the gold-v9 investigation, now under the retained positive arc

timing_laws.frontier_role: alternate surviving timing law under the same arc
timing_laws.label: native-pocket
timing_laws.mechanism: donor-band tempo scale fixed at 1.0; the band keeps its native pocket and natural drift is accepted
timing_laws.why: the alternate surviving timing law under the same arc; tests whether preserving the drummer's native feel beats synchronization over a full form

timing_laws.frontier_role: explicit phrase-reset control on the same source and form
timing_laws.label: phrase-reset
timing_laws.mechanism: one constant tempo scale per four-slot phrase, re-cued only at phrase boundaries, so the pocket is stable inside each phrase and every synchronization change is hidden at a boundary
timing_laws.phase_rule: re-cue only at four-slot phrase boundaries
timing_laws.tempo_rule: one tempo scale per four-slot phrase
timing_laws.why: the explicit phrase-reset control on the same source and form
